verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own guides describe blocking specific merchants, merchant categories, or merchant IDs. That covers the blocklist side of MCC and merchant restriction. However, the evidence is a single one-line summary with no detail, and it never mentions allowlists or locking a card to a single merchant. missing for 10: MCC allowlists, single-merchant lock (allow-only-one-merchant), explicit confirmation that rules are enforced at authorization time, in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can restrict where a card works — merchant category (MCC) allowlists and blocklists, and single-merchant locks — applied at authorization time

citations.quote: Protege a tus clientes bloqueando comercios específicos, categorías o IDs de comercio.
